verses.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses after the death of Aaron’s two sons, just before they stood before Jehovah. They died.
verses.2: And the LORD said to Moses, “Speak to Aaron, your brother, and tell him that he must not ever go into the Holy Place from outside the veil that covers the Ark. He must not die, for I will see him on the ark through a cloud.”
verses.3: In that day, Aaron will come before the Holy One, in the morning, for his sin and for his transgressions.
verses.4: As for those who enter the holy place, they shall wash their bodies and hands. In the inner chamber, they shall also wash their clothes and garments. They shall then bathe their bodies in the water used for sacred purposes.
verses.5: And from the tribe of Israel, take two of the youngest sheep for their sins, and one lamb for the offering.
verses.6: And Aaron offered the sin offering that belonged to him, along with all the offerings that were given for his household.
verses.7: And he took the two lambs and placed them before Jehovah, at the entrance to the Temple.
verses.8: And Aaron gave two silver rings; one ring for Jehovah, and one ring for Azazel.
verses.9: And Aaron offered the lamb that had the plague on it to Jehovah. He made it a sin.
verses.10: And the young man on whom the plague had appeared, will stand before Jehovah to be sent away to Azazel.
verses.11: And Aaron offered the sacrifice for his sin. He also offered sacrifices for himself and for his household. Then he slaughtered the sacrifice for his sin.
verses.12: And he took some of the oil from the altar, from before Jehovah. He filled its vessels with this oil. Then he brought it back to the house of the priest.
verses.13: And he placed the incense on the fire before Jehovah. He covered the incense with a cloud, so that it wouldn’t die.
verses.14: And he took some blood from the grape, and applied it to the forehead of the lamb, in front of its mouth. And on the forehead of the lamb, he applied seven drops of that blood.
verses.15: And he slaughtered the skin of the sheep, which was for the sacrifice. Then he brought its blood into the sanctuary to be used for the offering. He did this according to how they were accustomed to do it with the blood of other sacrifices. Then he spread the blood on the altar and in front of the altar.
verses.16: And they will cover the Holy Place with their sins and misdeeds of the Israelites. In this way, they will also cover the Tabernacle with their sins.
verses.17: And no one shall be in the tent of the Lord when he comes to offer sacrifices on the Sabbath day, until he has finished his sacrifice and eaten with his family and with all the people of Israel.
verses.18: And he went to the altar that was before Jehovah. He sprinkled blood from the lamb and from the goat on the horns of the altar.
verses.19: And it was cleansed from the blood on its surface seven times. It became holy through the sprinkling of the blood by the children of Israel.
verses.20: And he sacrificed the sacred things, as well as the altar and the sacrificial altar. He also offered the living animal as an offering.
verses.21: And Aaron laid his two hands on the head of the living animal. He bowed down over it, and he blamed all the sins of the Israelites and all their transgressions. Then he placed them on the head of the animal, and sent them away by the hand of one of his servants.
verses.22: And the dove carried all their belongings to a foreign land, and then sent the dove back into the sky.
verses.23: And Aaron came to the holy tent. He took off his clothes that he had worn when he entered the Holy Place, and he placed them there.
verses.24: And he bathed his body in the water, in a holy place. Then he washed his clothes, and after that he went out and performed the rituals for the people. He stood among them, along with the entire crowd.
verses.25: And the milk of sin will be burned by the fire.
verses.26: And the one who sends the lamb to be sacrificed will wrap it in clothes, and then wash its body in the water. After that, it will be brought to the place of sacrifice.
verses.27: And the carcass of the sinner, and the hair of the sinner, which had come into contact with blood in the holy place. They were taken outside the camp and burned with fire. Their bodies, their clothes, and their hair were also burned.
verses.28: And the one who burns them will wrap himself in his clothes, and he will wash his body in the water. After that, he will come to the camp.
verses.29: And it shall be for you a law forever: in the seventh month, on the twentieth day of the month, you shall observe a day of solemnity. You shall not do any work outside your homes. The stranger who lives among you shall also observe this day.
verses.30: For on this day, it will be your duty to cleanse yourselves from all their sins before the LORD. So, purify yourselves.
verses.31: The Sabbath of the Sabbath is for you; and you have fulfilled your hearts with the commandment of eternity.
verses.32: And the priest’s clothes, which he wears; and the clothes that he puts on his hands when he is a priest under his father’s authority. He also tucks the sacred garments into the sacred clothes.
verses.33: And he will destroy the holy place of holiness, and also the altar of sacrifice. He will destroy the priests and all the people who belong to that community.
verses.34: And this shall be a law for you forever, so that you may punish the children of Israel for all their sins once a year. And they shall do as Jehovah commanded Moses.
